## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the IoT scenario where this feature would be used. For example:
- Which device types?
- Which sensor/actuator types?
- Home automation, agriculture, industrial, etc.?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.
